# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]
[GettyImages-1178

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

precise surgery.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to
  support the entire healthcare ecosystem.

  All Businesses Listings
  
  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.

  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

[2021 annual report][95]

the site. If you have already subscribed you can also log-in through the link.

## Share price

medicines that bring hope to those in greatest need.

# Changing what it means to live with diabetes

##### Resource

From early warning signs to emergency treatment, this guide explains how to recognize and manage low
blood sugar.

Learn More About Low Blood Sugar

Learn how tools like CGMs, pumps, and smart insulin pens can simplify diabetes management and
improve daily life.

Your Diabetes Technology Guide

This playbook explains diabetes complications—from early warning signs to prevention and
treatment—so you can protect your health.

The Complications Playbook

][231]

## Who We Serve

Through platforms, programs, resources and grants, we are uniting the global diabetes community and
providing solutions to improve lives. We aim to change what it means to live with chronic illness.

[

##### People living with
##### Type 1

Living with type 1 diabetes means managing blood sugar daily, but it’s possible to thrive with the
right tools and support.

][232] [

##### Prediabetes

Diagnosed with prediabetes? You’re not alone. While it can feel overwhelming, you have the ability
to make lifestyle changes that can bring your blood glucose levels back to normal.

][233] [

##### People living with
##### Type 2

With the right resources, programs and power of our combined voices, we can redefine what it means
to be a person living with diabetes—of any type.

][234] [

##### Type 1 Caretakers

Being a caretaker for people living with diabetes means providing essential support with tasks like
blood sugar monitoring, meal planning, and managing medication.

][235] [

##### Type 2 Caretakers

Being a caretaker is a role that requires patience, understanding, and adaptability to help ensure
their health and well-being while navigating the emotional aspects of care.

][236] [

##### Advocates

Advocates for people living with diabetes play a vital role in improving the lives of those affected
by this condition.

][237] [

##### Healthcare Providers

Helping to educate healthcare providers with the latest news about diabetes from industry and the
community.

][238]

by this condition.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted

underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

#### Fitterfly's Metabolic Health Program Suite

Fitterfly (a division of PB health) is an Indian health tech start-up dedicated to helping people
take control of their **metabolic health** from the comfort of their homes. It is founded and run by
a team of doctors, engineers, and experts in nutrition, fitness, and stress management. Fitterfly
offers scientific and personalized programs to prevent and manage several health conditions such as
diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and more.

Designed to complement your Doctor's medical therapy, Fitterfly programs offer personalized guidance
and motivation on nutrition, exercise, stress, weight, and sleep management. With a unique
combination of human and technological interventions, Fitterfly programs help people with various
conditions improve their health from the comforts of their homes.

Our clinically validated programs are at the forefront of digital health, delivering evidence &
research-based treatment through advanced software solutions. Our programs helps patients prevent,
reverse or manage their health conditions effectively. Our programs treatment relies heavily on
improving outcomes by changing patient behavior slowly and steadily. Fitterfly currently offers
several programs for conditions such as diabetes, obesity/weight loss & heart health.

Our digital health programs are trusted by 1000+ doctors for our data-based approach and and strong
foundation in scientific principles. Fitterfly is one of the few companies in India that leverages
intensive behavioral therapy to drive sustainable lifestyle changes that continue even after the
program concludes.

Our clinically validated program is available on the Fitterfly application (play store and apple
store) which includes video consultations that you can schedule at your convenience. We also offer a
freemium program for you to experience for 7 days.

#### Fittefly Diabetes Prime: India's first complete solution for Type 2 diabetes

[Fitterfly Diabetes Prime][79] is a digital health-based diabetes management program created and run
by Fitterfly. It is one of the best 1-year diabetes care programs in India, designed by experts and
doctors to provide a complete solution for Type 2 diabetes management.

Founded on the guiding principles of the 'legacy effect', which shows that controlling your blood
sugar levels for 1 year with intensive behavior therapy can have lasting positive effects on your
complications and risks.

This is one of the few health programs in India that provides real-time blood sugar insights with a
Continuous glucose monitor (CGM), which can be conveniently read from your phone. Additionally, it
includes a comprehensive set of blood tests covering over 100+ parameters.

[Fitterfly Diabetes Prime][80] offers personalized support from a dedicated team of health
coaches—including nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness experts, mental wellness specialists and
doctors. The program empowers people to make sustainable lifestyle changes that continue long after
completing the program.

As the aim of this program is not only to help you achieve your health goals but also empower you to
become an expert at diabetes management, it is also complete with educational modules that help you
better understand your condition and how your lifestyle plays a role in blood sugar management.

#### Fitterfly Weight Loss: A Scientific Weight Loss Program that Works

Unlike other weight loss programs in the market, Fitterfly Weight Loss is India's only science-based
[weight loss program][81]. Created by a team of experts at Fitterfly, Fitterfly Weight Loss aims to
reset your BMI to 23 kg/sq.m - the normal/healthy weight range.

Fitterfly Weight Loss offers personalized weight loss diet plans from expert nutritionists to help
you achieve your weight loss goals.

Along with a detailed and personalized diet plan for weight loss, Fitterfly Weight Loss also offers
weight loss tips around exercise from a physiotherapist and mental wellness from a clinical
psychologist for an overall holistic approach to achieve the best weight loss results.

#### Fitterfly's Metabolic Health Program Suite

Fitterfly (a division of PB health) is an Indian health tech start-up dedicated to helping people
take control of their **metabolic health** from the comfort of their homes. It is founded and run by
a team of doctors, engineers, and experts in nutrition, fitness, and stress management. Fitterfly
offers scientific and personalized programs to prevent and manage several health conditions such as
diabetes, obesity, hypertension, and more.

Designed to complement your Doctor's medical therapy, Fitterfly programs offer personalized guidance
and motivation on nutrition, exercise, stress, weight, and sleep management. With a unique
combination of human and technological interventions, Fitterfly programs help people with various
conditions improve their health from the comforts of their homes.

Our clinically validated programs are at the forefront of digital health, delivering evidence &
research-based treatment through advanced software solutions. Our programs helps patients prevent,
reverse or manage their health conditions effectively. Our programs treatment relies heavily on
improving outcomes by changing patient behavior slowly and steadily. Fitterfly currently offers
several programs for conditions such as diabetes, obesity/weight loss & heart health.

Our digital health programs are trusted by 1000+ doctors for our data-based approach and and strong
foundation in scientific principles. Fitterfly is one of the few companies in India that leverages
intensive behavioral therapy to drive sustainable lifestyle changes that continue even after the
program concludes.

Our clinically validated program is available on the Fitterfly application (play store and apple
store) which includes video consultations that you can schedule at your convenience. We also offer a
freemium program for you to experience for 7 days.

#### Fittefly Diabetes Prime: India's first complete solution for Type 2 diabetes

[Fitterfly Diabetes Prime][79] is a digital health-based diabetes management program created and run
by Fitterfly. It is one of the best 1-year diabetes care programs in India, designed by experts and
doctors to provide a complete solution for Type 2 diabetes management.

Founded on the guiding principles of the 'legacy effect', which shows that controlling your blood
sugar levels for 1 year with intensive behavior therapy can have lasting positive effects on your
complications and risks.

This is one of the few health programs in India that provides real-time blood sugar insights with a
Continuous glucose monitor (CGM), which can be conveniently read from your phone. Additionally, it
includes a comprehensive set of blood tests covering over 100+ parameters.

[Fitterfly Diabetes Prime][80] offers personalized support from a dedicated team of health
coaches—including nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness experts, mental wellness specialists and
doctors. The program empowers people to make sustainable lifestyle changes that continue long after
completing the program.

As the aim of this program is not only to help you achieve your health goals but also empower you to
become an expert at diabetes management, it is also complete with educational modules that help you
better understand your condition and how your lifestyle plays a role in blood sugar management.

#### Fitterfly Weight Loss: A Scientific Weight Loss Program that Works

Unlike other weight loss programs in the market, Fitterfly Weight Loss is India's only science-based
[weight loss program][81]. Created by a team of experts at Fitterfly, Fitterfly Weight Loss aims to
reset your BMI to 23 kg/sq.m - the normal/healthy weight range.

Fitterfly Weight Loss offers personalized weight loss diet plans from expert nutritionists to help
you achieve your weight loss goals.

Along with a detailed and personalized diet plan for weight loss, Fitterfly Weight Loss also offers
weight loss tips around exercise from a physiotherapist and mental wellness from a clinical
psychologist for an overall holistic approach to achieve the best weight loss results.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries. 

[More about GMP+ International ][52]

[Image]
[Image]

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

Go directly to: 
[GMP+ Feed Safety Assurance (GMP+ FSA][53][)][54]

[GMP+ Feed Responsibility Assurance (GMP+ FRA)][55]

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# Modern insulin pen for all

#### GO-PEN® is the first FDA-cleared and CE certified reusable insulin pen with user-filled
#### reservoir, built for the 20+ million people worldwide still using syringes for daily
#### injections. One pen lasts three years, delivering precise dosing at comparable syringe cost.

[ Discover GO-PEN® ][22]

#### **News: 11 November, 2025**

### Go-Pen receives CE Mark (class IIb) for its user-fillable insulin pen.

[ Go to news ][23]

# The change

## GO-PEN® brings

#### Most insulin leaves the factory in vials—the same affordable format used for decades. But until
#### now, using that insulin meant choosing between expensive pre-filled pens or outdated syringes.

#### GO-PEN®'s user-filled reservoir bridges this gap. People fill their own pen directly from an
#### insulin vial, combining pen precision vial affordability. No more daily pharmacy. No more
#### compromised dosing. No more stigma.

# Endorsed

## by healthcare leaders worldwide

#### Leading specialists in diabetes care, humanitarian medicine, and government health systems
#### recognize GO-PEN®'s approach to closing the delivery gap.

“GO-PEN® is the most innovative concept that I have ever seen towards the needs of patients who take
insulin using syringes”

— Anne Peters, Professor, Keck School of Medicine, USC, Los Angeles

——————————————

“The device has the potential to bring ease of use, dosing safety, and treatment adherence, to
underserved populations.”

— Amylya Reddy, MD, NCD Specialist, Médecins Sans Frontières

———————————————

“I am very excited about GO-PEN® being available, especially in low- and middle-income countries
where people really should have the option to be able to use the type of delivery device that they
wish to. What stands out for me is that it's a universal device.”

— Nupur Lalvani, Founder of Blue Circle Foundation, India

# The global

# diabetes challenge

#### **Addressing the inequity
#### **While insulin pens have been available since the 1980s, cost barriers mean millions still
#### rely on syringes, particularly in low- and middle-income countries where 86.9% of people with
#### undiagnosed diabetes live.

#### GO-PEN® addresses this gap by making modern pen technology accessible at comparable syringe
#### cost—democratizing diabetes care for the millions left behind.

#### **589 million** adults worldwide live with diabetes — that's 1 in 11 people. **20+ million**
#### people with diabetes still use syringes instead of modern insulin pens. **252 million** adults
#### with diabetes remain undiagnosed globally. **Over $1 trillion** was spent on diabetes care in
#### 2024 — 12% of global health expenditure. **3.4 million** people died from diabetes-related
#### causes in 2024.

**Source: **International Diabetes Federation. IDF Diabetes Atlas, 11th Edition.

# It’s time

## to move beyond syringes

#### Syringe dependency shouldn't be the only option in 2025. Millions worldwide face this choice
#### daily: expensive pre-filled pens or outdated syringes. GO-PEN® changes this - delivering pen
#### precision at comparable syringe cost.

[ Discover GO-PEN® ][24]
[ Partner with us ][25]

## Subscribe to our newsletter.

Sign up with your email address to receive news and updates.

* GO-Pen was recognised for being the only insulin pen where people with diabetes can buy insulin in
  vials and fill their own reservoirs for use with an insulin pen. See [press release][26]
* In the diabetes devices category, GO-Pen was recognised for its vision is to make a difference for
  the millions of people living with diabetes who currently cannot afford modern devices. See [news
  release][27]
* GO-Pen was a finalist in the category Startup in the Sealand Region. See [more][28].
* GO-Pen was a finalist in the category Social Entrepreneurship - Future Impact. See [list][29].

[ Go to news ][23]

#### Most insulin leaves the factory in vials—the same affordable format used for decades. But until
#### now, using that insulin meant choosing between expensive pre-filled pens or outdated syringes.

#### GO-PEN®'s user-filled reservoir bridges this gap. People fill their own pen directly from an
#### insulin vial, combining pen precision vial affordability. No more daily pharmacy. No more
#### compromised dosing. No more stigma.

#### recognize GO-PEN®'s approach to closing the delivery gap.

insulin using syringes”

underserved populations.”

where people really should have the option to be able to use the type of delivery device that they
wish to. What stands out for me is that it's a universal device.”

— Nupur Lalvani, Founder of Blue Circle Foundation, India

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

* Markets and territories covered

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like

supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies

offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

Beyond filings

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same
shareholders) supplies the market intelligence, sector research, and procurement data that informs
every recommendation.

1
**India Entry & Feasibility Studies**

Pre-feasibility, market sizing, FDI route, entity selection, regulatory mapping, and 90-180-365 day
operating plan.

2
**GTM Strategy & Channel Architecture**

Six to ten week sprints ending in a binding plan: segment priorities, channel design, P&L, hiring
and regulatory checklist.

3
**M&A, Valuation & Transfer Pricing**

Buy-side and sell-side advisory, registered-valuer reports, transfer pricing studies and 3CEB
filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

## Our advantage 01

#### Comprehensive Quality Assurance

Kindly Group as professional medical device manufacturer has a variety of qualifications and
certificates include CE conformity, FDA approval, ISO13485, TGA and MDSAP. These certifications
assure regulators and consumers that medical devices are manufactured according to established
standards and guidelines, ensuring their safety and effectiveness.

## Our advantage 02

#### Competitive Advantage and Global Acceptance

Medical devices with the required certification are recognized globally, which means that
manufacturers can sell their products globally. By obtaining the required certifications, Kindly
Group gains a competitive advantage over competitors. Compliance with these standards gives
resellers, healthcare providers and end users confidence that medical devices are safe, effective
and reliable.

## Our advantage 03

#### Reduce Risk and Improve Quality Assurance

Kindly Group as a certified medical device manufacturers reduce the risk of product recalls,
liability claims due to non-compliance. The certification process includes quality assurance
assessments to ensure that manufacturers produce medical devices that meet established product
design, development, and manufacturing standards.

## Our advantage 01

#### Innovative Design

Kindly Group has been a trusted name in medical device manufacturing for over decades. The
innovative design used to create its devices have made the company a force to be reckoned with in
the healthcare industry. This is achieved by investing heavily in research and development, ensuring
that the devices produced is at the cutting edge of medical technology. Kindly Group is able to
provide user-friendly, efficient and effective medical devices.

## Our advantage 02

#### Process Flow

Kindly Group has a complete technological process to ensure the highest quality of its medical
devices. We manufacture medical devices using cutting-edge technology and equipment, ensuring they
meet the stringent standards required by the healthcare industry.

## Our advantage 01

#### Price and Cost Advantage

The price and cost advantage of Kindly Group is a major factor in attracting customers. The group
invests heavily in R&D to create top-of-the-line medical devices affordable to consumers. The R&D
team works tirelessly to reduce production costs without sacrificing product quality. Therefore,
Kindly Group can provide customers with competitive prices without compromising the quality of
medical equipment.

## Our advantage 02

#### After-Sales Service

Kindly Group also provides comprehensive after-sales service. The team at Kindly Group understands
that medical devices require ongoing support to function at the highest level. Therefore, we provide
professional support through a dedicated customer service team, technical experts and maintenance
team. These teams work tirelessly to ensure that our customers are completely satisfied with the
products they purchase.

## Our advantage 01

#### Market Leadership

Kindly Group has a wide range of innovative products and a team of experts who work tirelessly to
ensure their equipment meets the ever-changing needs of the industry. Kindly Group has taken this
approach and continues to lead the industry through breakthrough innovations that have helped
countless patients around the world.

## Our advantage 02

#### Global Marketing Network

The global marketing network of Kindly Group is another advantage that sets them apart from the
competition. By having a presence in key markets around the world, companies can reach a wider
audience and position their products as industry standards. This global marketing presence ensures
that these devices are available to patients in different parts of the world, thereby expanding the
reach of medical innovation.

## About us

#### WE OFFER THE BEST QUALITY PRODUCTS

Shanghai Kindly Enterprise Development Group Co., Ltd (hereinafter referred to as the “Company” or
“KDL”, stock code: 603987) was founded in Wenzhou in 1987 and has expanded its operations into the
Yangtze River Delta region, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei metropolitan economic zone, and the
Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. The Company specializes in the research, development,

## Our advantage 01

#### Comprehensive Quality Assurance

Kindly Group as professional medical device manufacturer has a variety of qualifications and
certificates include CE conformity, FDA approval, ISO13485, TGA and MDSAP. These certifications
assure regulators and consumers that medical devices are manufactured according to established
standards and guidelines, ensuring their safety and effectiveness.

## Our advantage 02

#### Competitive Advantage and Global Acceptance

Medical devices with the required certification are recognized globally, which means that
manufacturers can sell their products globally. By obtaining the required certifications, Kindly
Group gains a competitive advantage over competitors. Compliance with these standards gives
resellers, healthcare providers and end users confidence that medical devices are safe, effective
and reliable.

## Our advantage 03

#### Reduce Risk and Improve Quality Assurance

Kindly Group as a certified medical device manufacturers reduce the risk of product recalls,
liability claims due to non-compliance. The certification process includes quality assurance
assessments to ensure that manufacturers produce medical devices that meet established product
design, development, and manufacturing standards.

## Our advantage 01

#### Innovative Design

Kindly Group has been a trusted name in medical device manufacturing for over decades. The
innovative design used to create its devices have made the company a force to be reckoned with in
the healthcare industry. This is achieved by investing heavily in research and development, ensuring
that the devices produced is at the cutting edge of medical technology. Kindly Group is able to
provide user-friendly, efficient and effective medical devices.

## Our advantage 02

#### Process Flow

Kindly Group has a complete technological process to ensure the highest quality of its medical
devices. We manufacture medical devices using cutting-edge technology and equipment, ensuring they
meet the stringent standards required by the healthcare industry.

## Our advantage 01

#### Price and Cost Advantage

The price and cost advantage of Kindly Group is a major factor in attracting customers. The group
invests heavily in R&D to create top-of-the-line medical devices affordable to consumers. The R&D
team works tirelessly to reduce production costs without sacrificing product quality. Therefore,
Kindly Group can provide customers with competitive prices without compromising the quality of
medical equipment.

## Our advantage 02

#### After-Sales Service

Kindly Group also provides comprehensive after-sales service. The team at Kindly Group understands
that medical devices require ongoing support to function at the highest level. Therefore, we provide
professional support through a dedicated customer service team, technical experts and maintenance
team. These teams work tirelessly to ensure that our customers are completely satisfied with the
products they purchase.

## Our advantage 01

#### Market Leadership

Kindly Group has a wide range of innovative products and a team of experts who work tirelessly to
ensure their equipment meets the ever-changing needs of the industry. Kindly Group has taken this
approach and continues to lead the industry through breakthrough innovations that have helped
countless patients around the world.

## Our advantage 02

#### Global Marketing Network

The global marketing network of Kindly Group is another advantage that sets them apart from the
competition. By having a presence in key markets around the world, companies can reach a wider
audience and position their products as industry standards. This global marketing presence ensures
that these devices are available to patients in different parts of the world, thereby expanding the
reach of medical innovation.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

About Us

Found in 2009,Wuxi NEST Biotechnology is a worldwide manufacturer of plastic laboratory products.
State-of-the-art manufacturing equipment is used on an expansive manufacturing site based in Wuxi,
China. Decades of plastic-injection molding experience allows us to maintain the highest quality and
performance standards expected by the hospitals, research institutions and indusrial/clinical
laboraories that we serve, NEST is your best choice for laboratory consumables. NEST has launched
over 200 plastic consumable products for cell culture, molecular bislogy, immunoassays, liquid
handling and storage. With stricty controlled ISO 8 grade clean rooms, exacting manufacturing
standards and rigid QA procedures, the NEST brand enjoys an excellent reputation nationwide and
abroad. NEST products have been exported to North America, Europe, Japan, Korea, India and other
countries. NEST is committed to innovation. We continue to research and develop new platic
consumables suitable for life sciences research so that we can provide more cost-effective solutions
and cutting-edge laboratory consumables for our end-users. NEST has continually positioned itself as
a brand for high end laboratory consumables. NEST boasts of a high power laminar flow clean room
meeting the ISO 8 grade with a floor space of 2,000 square meters. These facilities are equipped
with a central feeding system, high precision injection machinery from Japan, robot arms with
automatic conveyers, hot runner molds, and vacuum plasma and corona treatment machines from Belgium,
Germany and USA. Inner room moisture content and temperature are adjustable. In 2013, NEST installed
a Rhodotron TT 200 from Belgium IBA, a world leader in the E-Beam sterilization industry. NEST
completes a full process chain from the sourcing of the raw materials to the in-house sterilization
of the final products ready for delivery to clients. NEST`s manufacturing site has been certified
with an ISO 9001:2008 management system. Our sterilization procedures meet the ISO 11137:2006 and
ISO 13485 standards.
